static_traits.name: Li Na
static_traits.family_status: 父亲是传教士，有一个3岁的孩子
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因持续担忧Student表现而变得紧张
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史，without既往心理治疗史；近期受工作压力影响出现睡眠问题
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、能具体描述trigger情境与影响；情绪基调偏负面，常use灾难化及“全或without”式表述；配合度较高，能与咨询师共同设定小目标

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直在为“我的Student在我的课堂上表现not好，并且最终会失败”的想法而苦恼。这种信念让我非常痛苦，也影响了我的教学能力。
basic_info.core_demands: 理想状态下，我想在工作中重新获得自信，not再时刻担心丢掉工作或犯错。
growth_experiences: 学年开始时，Li Na注意到部分Student在某些概念上学习吃力，由此产生“Student在我的课堂上表现not好并最终会失败”的想法。这些想法在课堂教学及备课时每日出现，随每周递进而加重，尽管她尝试实施新的教学策略并为Student提供额外支持，想法仍持续存在。
大约一个月前，上司开玩笑说她“单手打字”，引发强烈羞耻与被negate感。此后在工作中持续担心被视为without能，害怕出错并回避与同事及上司接触；出现Sleep disturbance、进食not规律、持续紧张与Decreased attention，尤其在团队会议或上司审阅工作时加剧。
原生与现状：父亲是传教士；目前Married并育有一名3岁孩子，配偶支持度较高。

core_beliefs: Student的成败完全取决于我，若他们失败就等于我失败

special_situations.event: 新学年开始后，发现部分Student对关键概念掌握困难
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果有Student跟not上我的教学，就说明我是失败的老师
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 加班备课、实施新教学策略并提供额外支持，同时not断反复担忧Student表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会一直学not好，最后都会not及格；我在失败

special_situations.event: 在课堂和备课时反复关注Student作业与测评中的问题
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能把所有问题都消除，最终结果就会很糟糕
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Over-monitors and repeatedly checks teaching details, tries to use more methods to 'correct everything'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: not管我怎么做，他们最终还是会失败

special_situations.event: Interacting with supervisor（如团队会议、工作审阅）并联想到一个月前的玩笑
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果上司曾嘲讽或注意到我的not足，就代表她认为我not称职，随时可能对我not利
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与上司和同事接触，设法证明价值但又not敢直接寻求反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她一定觉得我not行，我可能会丢掉工作

special_situations.event: When facing seemingly simple daily tasks, nervous for fear of making mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任务必须做得完美，否则就证明我without能
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 拖延或Over-preparation、反复确认以避免任何差错
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果有一点做not好，就全盘皆输

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be recognized as competent and to obtain stable, safe relationships and evaluations
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为without能而Being rejected/失去工作，并让Student失败而自我价值被negate
defense_goal: 通过回避权威情境与自我苛责来降低被negate的风险
以过度控制与完美化标准来暂时缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 容易犯错、需要not断自证的“问题员工/老师”
object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔、容易羞辱与negate人的上级/权威

object_relations.self_representation: 对Student负完全责任、必须把一切教好的老师
object_relations.object_representation: 脆弱且高度依赖自己成败的Student群体

manifestations: 对“责任—选择”的沉重感：将Student的学业成败完全归于自身责任
在上级面前害怕被negate，渴望外部认可与安全感
outcomes: 回避关键关系情境（上司、同事）

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 强调“我必须对Student的学业负责”，把Student成败等同于自身价值
Evaluates own performance by perfectionistic standards, with an extremely low tolerance for error

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on
manifestations: Avoids direct contact with supervisors and colleagues, reducing communication
在被审阅或会议情境前后尽量绕开对话以回避Anxiety刺激

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Persistent self-doubt与自责，担心一旦出错就证明自己without能
Overly cautious about work details, checks repeatedly, hard to relax

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse，可进行情感倾诉
具有既往Good的任务组织能力（过去擅长安排日常工作）
Proactively seeks professional help and is willing to set small, feasible goals
在教学中已尝试多种策略与额外支持以帮助Student
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括与全或without思维模式Reinforcementwithout助感
Excessive responsibility attribution and high dependence on external evaluation (seeks external validation)
回避权威与同事互动，导致Anxiety维持与功能下降
持续性担忧导致Sleep and diet disturbance，降低恢复力与专注度

target_behavior.behavior: 工作相关的Persistent anxiety与负性Anticipation（担心Student失败/被上司视为without能）
antecedent: 上司在场、团队会议或工作审阅时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将Student成败完全等同于自我价值，并将上级的玩笑与注意解读为对自身能力的negate，伴随灾难化与“全或without”信念
target_behavior.function: 短期内通过过度担忧和Self-monitoring来获得控制感、避免被评价的风险
target_behavior.consequence: 教学与Decreased work efficiency、Anxiety维持和加重、Sleep and diet disturbance、Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与上司和同事的接触
antecedent: 团队会议或工作被审阅前后
回想起上司关于“单手打字”的玩笑时
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被negate与被视为without能，将外部信号过度解释为威胁
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的评价情境以迅速降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 职场互动受损、支持与反馈减少，Anxiety与not安全感被维持

target_behavior.behavior: Sleep difficulties与进食紊乱（过食或忘记进食）
antecedent: 工作日夜间回想白天的担忧与失误
第二天有与上司相关的任务或会议时
target_behavior.core_reason: High-level physiological arousal driven by persistent worry; negative automatic thoughts are hard to interrupt
target_behavior.function: without功能性（症状性反应），与Anxiety互相Reinforcement
target_behavior.consequence: Energy declines, attention and executive function are impaired, further affecting teaching and work performance
